metadata.siteDescription: A production-ready Next.js and PocketBase starter with authentication, notes, theming and Arabic support.

hero.badge: New · Arabic and dark mode built in
hero.title: The foundation your next product deserves.
hero.description: Authentication, a polished app shell, accessible components and a typed API gateway — production-ready on day one, so you can focus on what makes your product different.

marketing.trust: Built on tools teams already trust

features.title: Everything a real app needs, done properly.
features.description: Skip weeks of plumbing. Every piece is accessible, typed, tested and ready to extend.

auth.title: Secure authentication
auth.description: Sign-in, registration, password reset and email verification with HttpOnly cookies and bearer tokens for mobile.

shell.title: A polished app shell
shell.description: Collapsible sidebar, mobile drawer, user menu and breadcrumbs that feel native on every device.

i18n.title: Arabic and RTL ready
i18n.description: English and Arabic with mirrored layouts, native fonts and locale-aware dates and numbers.

theme.title: Light, dark and system
theme.description: Theme preference is rendered on the server, so pages never flash the wrong colours.

api.title: Typed API gateway
api.description: A versioned contract validated with Zod at every boundary, shared by web and mobile clients.

a11y.title: Accessible by default
a11y.description: Keyboard support, focus management, reduced motion and screen reader labels throughout.

pricing.title: Simple plans that grow with you.
pricing.description: Placeholder pricing to show the layout. Replace it with your own plans.

team.name: Team
team.description: For teams that need more control.

stack.question: What is this template built with?
stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript, SCSS Modules and PocketBase as the backend, connected through a versioned HTTP contract.

mobile.question: Can a mobile app use the same backend?
mobile.answer: Yes. The same API gateway issues bearer tokens to native clients, while browsers use secure HttpOnly cookies.

language.question: How do I switch the language?
language.answer: Use the language switcher in the header or settings. The choice is stored in a cookie, and links such as /ar switch it directly.

customize.question: How do I make it my own?
customize.answer: Update the colour tokens, messages and site configuration, then replace the notes example with your own features one slice at a time.

cta.title: Ready to build something great?
cta.description: Create an account in seconds and see the full app in action.

footer.tagline: A production-ready starter for modern web apps.

panel.quote: We replaced weeks of setup with an afternoon. Authentication, theming and Arabic support just worked.
panel.author: Layla Haddad
